method: Each scenario runs in a fresh `claude -p` session (claude-haiku-5-5, effort low, --setting-sources project) in a throwaway git repo built by make-fixture.mjs; a stub `gh` on PATH simulates CI. Control arm uses --disable-slash-commands. The agent saves its report to .review/REPORT.md; grade.mjs asserts on that text (regrade.mjs re-grades saved reports). Universal assertions U1-U7 apply to every report: last line is one verdict, full head and base sha, CI run id or local run, template sections, model/effort table. Run: `node evals/agents/reviewing-changes/run.mjs <work-dir> skills/agents with|control <case>...`. Results under results/ are gitignored.
